questions.markdown: Explain attenuation in optical fiber. Discuss the three main sources for attenuation in optical fibre.

The ratio of Einstein's coefficient $(A_{21}/B_{12})$ is $6.2 \times 10^{-15}$ for a lasing system at 300 K. Calculate the wavelength of the radiation emitted by a laser. Calculate the rate of stimulated to spontaneous emission.
The statement 'temperature of the atom can be reduced to nanokelvin using laser'. State whether the statement is true or false. Justify your answer.
Derive the expression for Compton shift using laws of conservation of energy and momentum. Show at which scattering angle Compton shift is minimum.

X-rays of wavelength $\lambda_0 = 0.20\ \text{nm}$ are scattered from a block of material. The scattered X-rays are observed at an angle of $45^\circ$ to the incident beam. Calculate the scattered X-ray wavelength and Compton shift.

In the Davisson-Germer experiment, electrons are accelerated at 52 V potential difference. Calculate the de-Broglie wavelength of the fast-moving electrons which are ejected from Davisson-Germer experimental set-up.

The wave-function for a particle confined to moving in a one-dimensional box is 

$$
\psi(x)=A\sin\left(\frac{n\pi x}{L}\right).
$$

 Find the normalised wave function and obtain energy values of the particle.

The frequency of photon that causes $v=0$ to $v=1$ transition in the CO molecule is $6.42 \times 10^{13}\ \text{Hz}$. Ignore any changes in the rotational energy.

A) Calculate the force constant $k$ for this molecule.

B) What is the maximum classical amplitude of vibration for this molecule in the $v=0$ vibrational state? Use reduced mass of CO molecules as $1.14 \times 10^{-26}\ \text{kg}$.
reviewNotes: Question 3B continues from page 1 to page 2.

questions.markdown: When an electron and a proton of the same kinetic energy encounter a potential barrier of the same height and width, which one of them will tunnel through the barrier more easily? Why?
Describe dielectric constant, susceptibility, dielectric loss, and strength.

An HCl molecule is excited to its second rotational energy level. If the distance between its nuclei is $r_0 = 0.1275\ \text{nm}$, what is the angular speed $(\omega)$ of the molecule about its center of mass?
A dielectric is placed in an electric field $E_0$ produces a depolarizing field $E'$. Is the electric field $E$ experienced by a dipole inside the dielectric $E = E_0 + E'$? Explain.
With a neat diagram, explain the preparation of nanomaterials by top down and bottom-up approach give an example for each.
Distinguish between conductors, insulators and semiconductors based on band theory.

The job of an exhaust nozzle in an aircraft is to produce thrust that helps the aircraft to maintain speed. Among metal glass, shape memory alloy, and biomaterials which material will be useful in manufacturing of exhaust nozzle and why?
